scope: Correct implementation and reporting of the existing P4 contract before any candidate or matched-Richards model response. This is not a numerical-policy change, new scientific experiment, Reference qualification result or application acceptance.

findings.finding: Reference analyzer selected S17-S20 but its phase dictionary still used S09-S12; inherited compare_surface indexes PHASES by the selected history and raises KeyError S17.
findings.repair: Four dictionary keys and two history descriptions only. Phase sequences, numerical formulas and thresholds unchanged.
findings.concurrent_write_disposition: The same six-line repair appeared on the live branch during this audit. A stale-SHA write was rejected and the identical existing repaired blob was retained rather than overwritten.

findings.finding: The prepared closeout could label a numerically unqualified Layer-ROM as a closure deficit whenever qualified matched Richards reached the comparator.
findings.repair: Require numerical qualification of both methods for closure attribution. Unqualified Layer-ROM receives LAYER_ROM_NUMERICALLY_UNAVAILABLE; mismatched partitions and logically inconsistent reach flags are rejected.

findings.finding: The prepared frontier analyzers labeled the first qualified comparator-reaching rung as a minimum even when lower rungs had no qualified response.
findings.repair: Report first qualified reach separately. A minimum is established only when every lower frozen rung has qualified evidence that misses the comparator. Unknown numerical cases are not converted into state-information failures.

reference_wiring.original_behavior: KeyError: S17 reproduced using imported policy mocks
reference_wiring.fixture_scope: Relevant fields copied from the frozen preregistration for the local wiring test; the CI test reads the full unchanged repository preregistration.

future_execution_binding_requirements: Reference adjudication binds the repaired analyzer and the mandatory reference-wiring regression test.
Candidate, matched-Richards and closeout execution bindings include the new decision-policy module and their repaired analyzer/builder blobs.
Do not use the old prepared reporting code to infer minima or closure deficits.
A software-test PASS never opens the hydrological Reference gate. All required fresh Reference route sets must still qualify first.
